title: Nuoc Cham Dipping Sauce with Carrot
summary: Garlic, chilli and sugar crushed together, loosened with warm water and seasoned with fish sauce and lime, finished with carrot shreds.

ingredients.item: small red chilli, very finely chopped

steps.title: Make a paste
steps.text: Crush the garlic and chilli with 1 tsp of the sugar to a rough paste using a mortar and pestle or the flat of a knife.

steps.title: Dissolve the sugar
steps.text: Scrape the paste into the bowl, add the remaining sugar and the warm water, and stir until the liquid is clear.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in the fish sauce and lime juice. Taste: it should be a balance of sweet, sour, salty and hot. Adjust with a little more lime or sugar.

steps.title: Add the carrot
steps.text: Stir in the carrot shreds and leave for 10 min so they soften slightly. Serve in small bowls for dipping fresh rolls.

tips: Warm water helps the sugar dissolve fully.
Add more chilli for extra heat.
Fish sauce strength varies, so taste before adding all of it.
Shredded daikon can join the carrot.
storage: Keep in a covered jar in the fridge for up to 5 days; add the carrot just before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
